tools.name: company_status
tools.description: FREE, no key. Companies House status check for a UK company: pass company_number (e.g. 00445790) for status, name, incorporation and cessation dates, registered office postcode and has_insolvency_history; or pass name for the top matches with their company numbers. Live Companies House data, cached

tools.name: daily_new_companies
tools.description: FREE, no key. Daily data drop: yesterday's (UK date) new Companies House incorporations, grouped by SIC 2007 section/sector with counts and a few example company names and numbers. Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD, last 31 days). Also GET /daily/new-companies (JSON) or ?format=text (post-ready summary). So

tools.name: new_cos_discover
tools.description: Free peek: up to 5 newly incorporated UK companies for an area/location (e.g. London). Cached 24h. Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: new_cos_pack
tools.description: Paid pack of newly incorporated UK companies matching an area. Returns Stripe Checkout URL (£0.49) then redeem with one-time token. Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: kyb_pack
tools.description: Paid pack for one UK company number (profile, officers, PSC, filings, indicators). Indicators are not a due-diligence or Know Your Business opinion. Returns Stripe Checkout URL (£0.49). Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: redeem_pack
tools.description: Instructions to redeem a paid Stripe Checkout session (success redirect). Pass session_id from checkout.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: daily_new_companies · Private data: new_cos_pack · Public sink: daily_new_companies · Destructive: daily_new_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: daily_new_companies · Private data: new_cos_pack · Public sink: daily_new_companies · Destructive: daily_new_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
